newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy continuing gradual recovery--EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy continuing gradual recovery--EPA.

text.p: The government has not changed its official assessment that Japan's economic recovery is continuing at a gradual pace, the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said in its monthly report on Friday.
The government is closely monitoring how a planned increase in Japan's consumption tax to five percent from three percent on April 1 will affect the economy.
"The consumption tax rise may slow Japan's economic recovery, but the economy is certain to pick up later towards sustainable growth," said a senior EPA official in a briefing on the report.
Using exactly the same wording to summarise the report as in February, the EPA said capital spending is recovering and housing construction remains at a high level.
Private consumption is gradually recovering, while production is increasing.
"Private consumption is firm. The employment situation remains severe, but there are signs of improvement," the report said.
